Driver:jaime alguersuari (Jaime Alguersuari): A Spanish racing driver who competed in Formula One.
A driver who was not retained by Scuderia Toro Rosso.

Team:pirelli (Pirelli): Tyre supplier for Formula One since the reintroduction of slick tyres in 2009.
The tyre supplier where Jaime Alguersuari joined as a test driver.
Tyre supplier for the 2012 Formula One season.
The tyre supplier for the Grand Prix.
